[{"filename":"REPORTE DE INCIDENTE LABORAL.pdf","translation":"WORKPLACE INCIDENT REPORT – FALL
Incident Date: March 15, 2026
Time: 10:30 a.m.
Location: Warehouse area, aisle B
Affected Employee: Juan Pérez
Position: Warehouse Assistant
Supervisor: María López

Incident Description:
Employee Juan Pérez was moving boxes from the upper shelf to a mobile platform. While walking through aisle B, he slipped due to a wet surface that was not properly marked. As a result, he lost his balance and fell to the floor, impacting his right side.

Reported Injuries:
The employee reported pain in the right wrist and hip. Mild swelling was observed in the wrist. There was no loss of consciousness.

Immediate Actions:
The supervisor was notified immediately after the incident. The employee was assisted and transported to the occupational clinic for medical evaluation. First aid was administered at the site.

Cause of Incident:
Presence of liquid on the floor without adequate signage. Lack of prior area inspection.

Corrective Measures:
• Immediate cleaning of the affected area.
• Placement of "Wet Floor" signage.
• Reinforcement of inspection and safety protocols.
• Additional training for personnel on risk prevention.

Witnesses:
Ana Martínez (Operator)
Carlos Ruiz (Shift Supervisor)

Follow-up:
A safety review of the area will be conducted and monitoring will take place over the coming weeks to prevent similar incidents.
